name: 33130 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33130 (Miami) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33130 (Miami) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
72% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33130 (Miami) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 82% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
